title: Daily Market Briefing
text:
BOTTOM LINE — Muted tape, semis led, breadth narrow. CPI relief failed to spark broad risk-on; AI-infrastructure and DRAM strength carried the session while XLY and XLB faded. Volume lagged across the board, marking a low-conviction rally off familiar positioning.

INDICES — VIX 14.6, below its 17.0 ma20. SOXX +2.32%, QQQ +0.73%, IWM +0.57%, SPY +0.25%, DIA -0.02%. Large > small by 0.16pp. GLD +0.99% led cross-asset; USO -0.24%. SPY/QQQ remain above their 200-day MAs.

VOLUME — SPY vol_ratio 0.7x, QQQ absent from gaining list — both underperforming average, confirming low-participation rally. GLD 1.4x on an up day = accumulation; KWEB 2.0x on a -1.96% drop = distribution. Volume up on XLRE gains; XLY fading on 0.6x shows little conviction behind the selloff.

SECTORS & ROTATION — XLK +1.49%, XLRE +0.93%, XLU +0.48%, XLP +0.46%, XLV +0.26%, XLF +0.21%, XLE +0.16%, XLI +0.10%, XLC -0.90%, XLY -1.13%, XLB -1.24%. Top industries: DRAM +7.68%, WGMI +5.68%; bottom: XHB -1.77%, KWEB -1.96%. Money into semis/memory and REITs; money out of China exposure and discretionary. Rotation label: AI hardware leading.

POSITIONING — QQQ PCR_vol 1.31 elevated; IWM PCR_vol 0.40 complacent. QQQ GEX_flip 732 vs spot ~718 — price below flip, dealer hedging amplifying downside. VIX 14.6 below ma20 17.0 = complacency with no bond vol stress.

CROSS-ASSET — Gold +0.99% alongside silver +0.87% while tech rallied — unusual inflation-hedge bid despite dovish CPI. Natural gas +1.29% ignoring oil's -0.24%, diverging energy complex.

SIGNALS & WATCH — Fear & Greed 65.2 Greed. Movers: ANET +6.39% on insider sale headline, TER +6.11%, ORCL +5.36% on TikTok news. 20d momentum: XLE best +8.02%, XLC worst -2.74%. Watch: SOXX +2.32% on 20d -1.56% trend reversal, TER +6.11% with DRAM industry +7.68% vol spike, KWEB -1.96% on 2.0x distribution volume.
